description: This file defines the KafkaSourceProvider class for Apache Spark, handling Kafka data source registration, schema validation, source creation, relation creation, sink creation, and configuration validation for Kafka streaming and batch operations within Spark SQL. It includes internal classes for Kafka scanning, streaming, and metrics, as well as utility functions for Kafka offset management and parameter conversion.

classes.name: KafkaSourceProvider
classes.description: Object containing utility functions and constants for Kafka offset management and parameter conversion.

classes.name: KafkaSourceProvider.KafkaTable
classes.description: Supports reading from and writing to Kafka as a table within Spark SQL.

classes.name: KafkaSourceProvider.KafkaScan
classes.description: Implements scanning Kafka data for batch and streaming queries.

classes.name: OffsetOutOfRangeMetric
classes.description: Custom metric for tracking estimated out-of-range offsets.

classes.name: DataLossMetric
classes.description: Custom metric for tracking data loss errors.

methods.name: shortName
methods.description: Returns the short name identifier for the Kafka data source.

methods.name: sourceSchema
methods.description: Provides the schema and name of the Kafka source, validating options.

methods.name: createSource
methods.description: Creates a Kafka streaming source with unique group ID and offset limits.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Returns a Kafka table with header inclusion option.

methods.name: createRelation
methods.description: Creates a base relation for batch reading from Kafka with offset validation.

methods.name: createSink
methods.description: Creates a Kafka sink for writing data.

methods.name: createRelation (overloaded)
methods.description: Creates a base relation for writing data to Kafka, returning an unsupported relation.

methods.name: strategy
methods.description: Determines the Kafka subscription strategy based on parameters.

methods.name: failOnDataLoss
methods.description: Checks if the source should fail on data loss based on parameters.

methods.name: validateGeneralOptions
methods.description: Validates common Kafka source options, including strategy and Kafka configs.

methods.name: validateStreamOptions
methods.description: Validates options specific to streaming queries.

methods.name: validateBatchOptions
methods.description: Validates options specific to batch queries.

methods.name: kafkaParamsForDriver
methods.description: Builds Kafka consumer parameters for the driver.

methods.name: kafkaParamsForExecutors
methods.description: Builds Kafka consumer parameters for executors.

methods.name: convertToSpecifiedParams
methods.description: Converts parameters with 'kafka.' prefix to a map without the prefix.
